text:
Kai: Hey team, PTAL — pushed a follow-up to the kv-cache refactor PR. I addressed the comments about lock contention and the prefilling path, added a microbenchmark and a concurrency smoke test. Local + CI green. Need one more approver for a canary merge slot today.

Priya: Quick q — did you keep the soft-prefill path? that was helping the p99 previously.

Kai: Yes — kept the soft-prefill but moved it to a background worker to avoid blocking the hot path. short numbers from a quick local run: 
```
wrk -t2 -c100 -d30s http://localhost:8080
baseline p99: 95ms
after refactor (regression): 87ms
after this fix: 74ms
```

Jordan: LGTM from perf side. can you add a one-paragraph note in the PR about the background-worker tradeoff and why we removed the mutex? reviewers will ask. :eyes: 

Kai: Done — added the note and a concurrency test that simulates 200 concurrent reqs. also removed a redundant mutex in prefill that was unnecessary.

CI Bot: CI: all checks passed — unit, integration, perf-smoke. build 6789 ✅

Priya: I can give final approve after you squash the tiny logger change (nit).

Kai: Squashed and pushed. PTAL @Priya @Jordan — requesting merge window at 14:00 UTC (2pm) if there are no objections.

Sam: 14:00 UTC works for me, ops reserved the canary lane. if we need a rollback plan, ping me and i'll stand by.

Priya: :thumbsup: gave approve. nice work on the test coverage.

Jordan: Approve. nice catch on the mutex and good benchmark writeup.

Kai: Thanks all — merging in ~10m unless someone objects. i'll monitor canary and post metrics to #eng-sre.

Sam: Sounds good. will watch metrics on our side. :rocket:
